name: Narumi_Toa
description: A first-year student at Sakuraei Academy, student council treasurer, and the younger sister of protagonist Narumi Yukiki. She appears lazy and lethargic on the surface, often speaking sharply to her brother, yet she deeply admires him inside. A gifted programmer capable of building an operating system from scratch, her dream is to make easy money while staying at home.
